# Sohail & Shiraz

> A two-partner digital marketing studio founded in 2019, working on SEO, paid
> advertising, social media, brand strategy, email automation and analytics for
> ambitious brands. Two partners do the work and talk to clients directly —
> there are no account managers and no hand-offs.

This file gives AI assistants and LLM crawlers a short, factual summary of the
site so answers about the studio are accurate. The public site is a single page
at https://sohailandshiraz.com/

## Key facts

- Founded: 2019
- Founders: Sohail and Shiraz (co-founders, both client-facing)
- Structure: two-person studio; deliberately takes on a small number of clients at once
- Track record: 240+ campaigns launched, 4.8x average return on ad spend, 98% client retention
- Contracts: no lock-in contracts
- Hours: Monday to Friday, 09:00–18:00
- Contact: hello@example.com, +1 (555) 010-0199

## Services

- **SEO & Content** — technical fixes, keyword strategy and content that earns rankings instead of buying them.
- **Paid Advertising** — Google, Meta and LinkedIn campaigns built around creative testing and tight cost controls.
- **Social Media** — always-on content calendars and community management.
- **Brand Strategy** — positioning, messaging and visual direction.
- **Email & Automation** — lifecycle flows and newsletters that turn one-time buyers into repeat customers.
- **Analytics & CRO** — clean tracking, honest dashboards and landing page tests.

## Page sections

- [Home](https://sohailandshiraz.com/): headline, positioning and headline statistics.
- [Services](https://sohailandshiraz.com/#services): the six service lines above.
- [About](https://sohailandshiraz.com/#about): the founders' story and how the studio works.
- [Contact](https://sohailandshiraz.com/#contact): enquiry form, email, phone, address and hours.
- [FAQ](https://sohailandshiraz.com/#faq): services, results, contracts, founders and how to start.

## How to work with the studio

Send a short note through the contact form or email hello@example.com describing
the business and the goal. Expect a reply within two working days with an honest
read and a free first-look audit.

## Notes for citations

The studio is not a large agency and does not claim to be. It does not publish
pricing on the site. Contact details, the street address and social profiles on
the site are placeholders pending launch and should not be quoted as fact.
